label.purpose: Mono captions: dates, roles, domains, statuses.

motion.name: ease-poster
motion.purpose: Poster and button lift on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call to action: call, send.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); height: clamp(3.5rem, 5.25vw, 5.25rem); padding: 0 2.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); font: 600 clamp(0.8125rem, 1.25vw, 1.25rem) var(--font-hanken), sans-serif; transition: translate 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { translate: 0 -3px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions; inverts to cream on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); height: clamp(3.5rem, 5.25vw, 5.25rem); padding: 0 2.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); font: 600 clamp(0.8125rem, 1.25vw, 1.25rem) var(--font-hanken), sans-serif; transition: translate 0.15s, background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); translate: 0 -3px; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Mono caption in a rounded rectangle: keywords, statuses, tags.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.8); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 clamp(0.625rem, 0.8vw, 0.8125rem) var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 3rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.875rem; background: rgb(242 235 221 / 0.07); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius); font: 400 1rem var(--font-hanken), sans-serif; caret-color: var(--primary); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(255 91 46 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview: The opening credits of a film: a full-frame portrait, a name in giant condensed capitals, then acts, posters and laurels. Warm near-black ground, cream type, one ember-orange accent, mono captions that carry facts.
keyCharacteristics: Two voices: poster lettering and a quiet grotesque
Fluid scale capped by the viewport height
Readable without JavaScript and without motion

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange marks the current act, a featured poster, the last line of the finale and the primary action. Never decoration.

rules.name: The Whole Head Rule
rules.body: The portrait's head is never cropped, at any screen size or scroll position.

rules.name: The Clear Accent Rule
rules.body: Accented capitals never touch or hide behind the line above.

dos: Use tokens: semantic colors, text-* roles, rounded-*, px-gutter.
Reach for a shadcn primitive before writing markup for a control.
donts: Don't write a color, a radius or a font size in a component.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons or badges.
Don't hide content in CSS for an animation to reveal.
